# LIFT Link wire fixture -- SHARED, byte-identical in dugcanlift-lift-watch and
# dugcanlift-lift. Each line is a name and the hex bytes this protocol must produce for
# the matching object in LinkFixtures.kt.
#
# Do NOT regenerate this from the code under test. It exists so that a change to either
# repo's copy of the codec fails that repo's own LinkWireFixtureTest instead of
# producing a phone and a watch that half understand each other. Changing these bytes
# is a protocol version bump, made in both repos together.
#
# Version 2 added a coach's sides to a plan and nothing else. Every line below that existed at
# version 1 is unchanged, byte for byte, because sides are presence bits in masks version 1 already
# reserved -- so `plan`, which has none, still encodes to what it always did. The two lines added
# for version 2 are `plan.sides` and `frame.planRequestV2`; their bytes were derived field by field
# from this document's own "Payloads" and "Framing" sections by a separate implementation, not taken
# from the encoder they exist to police.
